```{r load-data, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# 1. Load Data
sotiriou <- read.table("/Users/gauri1399/Desktop/Classes/Sem3/Gene expression/Lab7/Sotiriou.txt", 
                       header = TRUE, row.names = 1)

# Read the sample annotation file (contains metadata like processing site)
sotiriou_annotation <- read.table("/Users/gauri1399/Desktop/Classes/Sem3/Gene expression/Lab7/Sotiriou_annotations.txt", 
                                  header = TRUE, row.names = 1)


# 1. PCA Analysis

library(ggplot2)

# Transpose dataset so samples are rows and genes are columns (required for PCA)
sotiriou_t <- t(sotiriou)

# Perform PCA and scale the data to have zero mean and unit variance
pca <- prcomp(sotiriou_t, scale = TRUE)

# Create a data frame containing principal component scores
pca_data <- as.data.frame(pca$x)

# Add a column for the processing site from annotation file
pca_data$site <- sotiriou_annotation$site

# Create PCA scatter plot (PC1 vs PC2) colored by processing site
ggplot(pca_data, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = site)) +
geom_point(size = 3) +
labs(title = "PCA Plot of Sotiriou Breast Cancer Dataset",
x = "Principal Component 1",
y = "Principal Component 2") +
theme_minimal() +
scale_color_manual(values = c("blue", "red")) +
theme(legend.title = element_blank())

# 2. Compute eigenvalues 
eigenvalues <- pca$sdev^2

# Create scree plot to visualize the importance of each principal component
scree_data <- data.frame(PC = 1:length(eigenvalues), Eigenvalue = eigenvalues)

ggplot(scree_data, aes(x = PC, y = Eigenvalue)) +
geom_bar(stat = "identity", fill = "blue") +
labs(title = "Scree Plot", x = "Principal Components", y = "Eigenvalue") +
theme_minimal()

# Calculate the proportion of variance explained by the first two PCs
variance <- eigenvalues / sum(eigenvalues)
explained_variance <- sum(variance[1:2])
explained_variance  # Print the value


# 3. MDS Analysis

library(MASS)

# Compute Euclidean distance between samples based on first two PCs
eucl_dist <- dist(pca_data[,1:2])

# Classic MDS: map high-dimensional data into 2D while preserving distances
classic_mds <- cmdscale(eucl_dist, k = 2)
classic_mds_df <- data.frame(MDS1 = classic_mds[,1],
MDS2 = classic_mds[,2],
Site = sotiriou_annotation$site)

# Plot Classic MDS
ggplot(classic_mds_df, aes(x = MDS1, y = MDS2, color = Site)) +
geom_point() +
labs(title = "Classic MDS Plot", x = "MDS1", y = "MDS2") +
theme_minimal() +
scale_color_manual(values = c("blue", "red"))

# Nonmetric MDS: preserves rank-order of distances rather than exact distances
nm_mds <- isoMDS(eucl_dist, k = 2)
nm_mds_df <- data.frame(MDS1 = nm_mds$points[,1],
MDS2 = nm_mds$points[,2],
Site = sotiriou_annotation$site)

# Plot Nonmetric MDS
ggplot(nm_mds_df, aes(x = MDS1, y = MDS2, color = Site)) +
geom_point() +
labs(title = "Nonmetric MDS Plot", x = "MDS1", y = "MDS2") +
theme_minimal() +
scale_color_manual(values = c("darkgreen", "magenta"))


# 4. Weighted Graph Laplacian

# Center and scale the gene expression matrix for Laplacian embedding
dd <- sotiriou
X <- t(dd)
temp <- scale(t(dd), center = TRUE, scale = TRUE)

# Convert site labels to numeric for coloring points
foo <- as.numeric(sotiriou_annotation$site)
leg <- unique(sotiriou_annotation$site)

# Define function for two-dimensional embedding using weighted graph Laplacian
k.speClust2 <- function(X, qnt = NULL) {
dist2full <- function(dis) {
# Convert distance object to full matrix
n <- attr(dis, "Size")
M <- matrix(0, n, n)
M[lower.tri(M)] <- dis
M + t(M)
}

dat.dis <- dist(t(X), "euclidean")^2  # Compute squared Euclidean distances
eps <- if (is.null(qnt)) min(dat.dis[dat.dis != 0]) else as.numeric(quantile(dat.dis, qnt))

K1 <- dist2full(exp(-dat.dis / eps)); diag(K1) <- 0  # Construct kernel matrix
tmpe <- rowSums(K1); tmpe[tmpe > 0] <- 1 / sqrt(tmpe[tmpe > 0]); tmpe[tmpe < 0] <- 0
D <- diag(tmpe)

# 5. Perform SVD and normalize
U <- svd(D %*% K1 %*% D)$u
U / sqrt(rowSums(U^2))
}

# Apply Laplacian embedding to scaled data
phi <- k.speClust2(X = t(temp), qnt = NULL)
plot(phi[,1], phi[,2], col = foo, pch = 19,
     xlab = "LE1", ylab = "LE2",
     main = "Two-Dimensional Weighted Graph Laplacian")
legend("topright", legend = leg, col = seq_along(leg), pch = 19, bty = "n")

```
